description: A scale quantizer with twelve semitone buttons setting which notes are allowed, plus a gate and a trigger reporting what it passes

params.text: Adds that semitone to the allowed scale or takes it out, and lights while the semitone is allowed

inputs.text: The pitch to be quantized, at a volt per octave, with every channel of the cable quantized
Moves the pattern of allowed notes to a new root, one semitone per twelfth of a volt, without shifting the output pitch
Names the semitone to be switched in or out of the scale, read at a volt per octave with the octave ignored
A rising edge switches the semitone named at the Note input in or out of the scale
A rising edge clears every note from the scale and sets the quantizer mode back to Closest, up

outputs.text: The quantized pitch, at a volt per octave
A 1ms trigger each time the quantized output moves to a different note
Carries 10V while the input pitch falls on an allowed note, and 0V while the quantizer is reaching for one; it drops to 0V for 1ms each time the quantized note changes, which retriggers an envelope

notes: a new Quantum allows no notes at all, so until one of the twelve key buttons is lit the Out jack holds the last note it gave, 0V on a fresh module, and Gate stays at 0V
menu: Quantizer Mode — what becomes of a pitch outside the scale: Last holds the note already playing, Up and Down search in one direction, and Closest, up and Closest, Down take the nearer one
Transpose — applies the Transpose voltage to the semitone arriving at the Note input before it is switched, and Don’t Transpose switches the semitone as played
Poly Gate Mode — keeps a semitone in the scale while any channel of the Toggle input holds it high, and Legacy Mode flips that semitone on every rising edge

inputs.1: 1V per octave · stepped · one channel only
inputs.4: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
